description: This image helps the reader understand that counts of commuting shuffles sorted by their number of joint orbits stay log-concave at every fixed orbit count except two, where the ratio collapses when n has many small divisors; with three shuffles the first certified failure is a 54-digit number.
head: Commuting shuffles: log-concavity breaks only at two orbits
sub: In every rank the two-orbit ratio collapses when n has many small divisors; at three or more orbits it holds for large n.

numbers.label: exact lim inf at ℓ = 3, k = 3 (bound was 1.10)
